content:
violet: Free pickup in SF office - LG 34' curved ultrawide (3440x1440) + fully adjustable monitor arm. Moving and can't take them. Pics in thread 1.

tom: omg nice. any dead pixels or backlight bleed?

violet: none visible, used for dev work. light scratch on underside bezel, not noticeable when on. comes with power cable and DP cable.
ravi: would love the arm if someone takes the monitor separately. is the arm vesa 100x100?
violet: yep, 100x100 and supports up to 9kg.
ops-bot: Reminder: tag items with your name and a claim-by time to avoid unclaimed storage.

tom: i'll take the monitor if @ravi passes on the arm. can you hold till 2pm today @violet?

violet: yes holding til 14:00. leaving both items in Floor 2 bike-room (next to lockers) with a post-it.
ravi: grabbing the arm! DMing to coordinate pickup at 1:30. thanks :raised_hands:
tom: thanks violet, i'll swing by after lunch.
violet: thanks all, leaving a note: Pickup: violet | Items: LG 34' curved + VESA arm | Claim by: 14:00 | Location: Floor 2 bike-room.
